Sandbox_MultiplayerTimeControls_WhoCanCo: The speed is one speed for the whole server: when somebody pauses or fast-forwards, it happens for everyone. Admins only: other players still see the buttons and the current speed, but cannot press them.
Sandbox_MultiplayerTimeControls_AllowPau: The pause button stops the world for everyone until somebody presses it again or picks a speed. Off: the pause button does nothing.
Sandbox_MultiplayerTimeControls_FastestS: The fastest fast-forward button that works. They are the single-player speeds: x1 is 5 times normal, x2 is 20 times, x3 is 40 times.
